Iran's Supreme Leader Khamenei's Funeral Processions Held in Iraq

Funeral ceremonies for Iran's late Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei took place in Iraq's holy cities of Najaf and Karbala. Large crowds of mourners attended processions as his coffin was transported through the cities. The events occurred amidst broader discussions about the escalating conflict in West Asia and statements from former US President Trump regarding a ceasefire.
